script: Executive or external search. Most staff recruiting runs through Cielo, Vanderbilt's recruiting partner, which focuses on roles at M four and below. Executive roles usually go to a search firm, and that changes how the requisition is created.
For Cielo's executive search program, create a recruiting requisition, and pick Executive search as the requisition type. A Cielo liaison takes the requisition, and a separate Cielo team recruits.

Any other firm, for example Korn Ferry, needs a P O requisition, not a recruiting requisition. Outside firms are paid differently, so the search can't be a requisition in Oracle Recruiting. Work with your procurement contact on the P O.
Everything else is Standard or Abbreviated. Executive search isn't for regular roles. See the course, Create a requisition.
One thing to remember. Confirm with central recruiting before you start an executive search.
